text:
rachel-docs: quick sync: noticed model-card examples use alias `aurora-lite` but the Private quickstart uses explicit `aurora-lite-quant-v1`. Could confuse readers.

tom-sdk: Good catch. We prefer aliases in quickstarts to keep them short but need to call out Private mapping differences.

anita-ml: Alias registry is populated in Hosted only. Private customers can opt-in but default installs don't include it.

rachel-docs: Proposed: update model-card example to show both forms and add a one-line note: 'If you run in Private, prefer explicit variant names or call Client.resolve_variant()'.

tom-sdk: I'll add a short snippet showing resolve_variant with link to SDK ref. Also add a defensive try/except example for IncompatibleVariantError.

opsbot: NOTE: opened PR #5518 for docs change (rachel-docs) and PR #5519 for SDK example update (tom-sdk).

anita-ml: Add a bench note too? Bench pages sometimes list variant-only numbers and that can mislead.

rachel-docs: Good idea. I'll add a bench tooltip: 'Benchmarks reported per-variant; alias mapping does not change throughput figures.'

tom-sdk: I'll review both PRs. Small nits aside, sounds good.

rachel-docs: PRs opened and CI queued. Thanks all.
